artifact_kind: actual matched three-repeat prompt-kernel timing and token-identity comparison

provenance.evidence_label: measured; portable projection of completed collection, no new model queries
provenance.canonical_hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false; ID arrays have no spaces. File hashes bind original file bytes.
provenance.source_artifacts: Original collection artifacts are retained locally, not shipped; their hashes are provenance, not downloadable links. Full paired emitted IDs and measured clocks are shipped below. Original prompt texts/ID files are not shipped.

exl3-405.json.manifest_hash_scope: Collection-time source-sealed bytes, not publication-only serving-default metadata.

vision-bf16.json.manifest_hash_scope: Collection-time source-sealed bytes, not publication-only serving-default metadata.

timing_and_token_conventions.decode: (number of all raw emitted IDs minus first_chunk_tokens)/(last emission ns minus first emission ns)*1e9; terminal EOS included. Runtime emission post-first-chunk proxy, not whole-request or isolated GPU-kernel throughput.
timing_and_token_conventions.ttft: (first emission ns - monotonic request_start_ns)/1e9; speculative chunk may contain multiple IDs.
timing_and_token_conventions.prefill: prompt_tokens/engine prefill_s, first-sample-inclusive native engine clock; not isolated GPU kernel time and not prompt_tokens/TTFT.
timing_and_token_conventions.elapsed: (request_end_ns-request_start_ns)/1e9; distinct from decode and prefill clocks.
timing_and_token_conventions.medians: Per suite+fixture, over all frozen repetitions; null preserved. No warmup excluded from the frozen measured rows. Completion counts include raw terminal EOS when emitted.
timing_and_token_conventions.sampling: native sampling=None argmax; temperature=0, top_k=0, top_p=1, min_p=0. Seed405 is fixture metadata, not a stochastic-seed guarantee.
timing_and_token_conventions.cache: Idle kept-chain prefix entries evicted per request; all measured engine_stats.cached=0. Page state uncontrolled-prefix-uncached, not cold OS pages. No matched cold/warm disk claim.
timing_and_token_conventions.identity: Direct comparison of full raw emitted ID arrays; not text/hash equality or semantic quality. Canonical token hashes in this projection derived from actual arrays.
timing_and_token_conventions.fixture_hashes: prompt_sha256 hashes prompt bytes; prompt_token_ids_sha256 hashes canonical ID arrays, not original whitespace-bearing ID-file bytes.

decision.scope: Prompt kernels ON by default on the unchanged 4.05bpw_h6_ng6 checkpoint and pinned TensorFold runtime. This is a prefill and TTFT improvement, not a decode-speed claim.
